select distinct store.[store_Id] Id, status.[emp_id] ,store.[name], store.[custCode], store.[code], store.[styp], store.[sv], store.[phone], store.dist_rule_id drId, status.[is_plan],ifnull(status.[status],0) actionState, store.[addr], store.[lvlcode], store.[lon] longitude ,store.[lat] latitude,status.[func_code] ,bf.[fv] as order_id,(case when acvtdis.answer is not null then acvtdis.answer else locacvtdis.answer end) as storeImg, wis.local_image as local_ImageID,wis.INTIME as inTime,wis.OUTTIME as outTime,attribute.acvt_qst_answer as attri ,store_month_visit_timeDis.acvt_qst_answer as store_month_visit_time, store.[storesFilter],store.[state],store.[last_man],store.[last_date],store.[distances] distance,store.[row_number], store.state,item_name,department_id as departmentId, store.ctyp ,storeStatus.optName,storeStatus1.monthVisitNumber,storeStatus2.monthHelpVisitNumber,localOrangeStore.answer,status.from_module as fromModuleName from ws_base_store_table store left join base_funcs bf on bf.opt like '%%isOrder%%' and fc in (select func_code from visit_store_action where store_id=store.store_Id) left join visit_store_status status on store.store_Id = status.store_id $funcCode$ left join wch_inoutStore wis on wis.store_id = store.store_Id and wis.emp_id = store.empId and wis.modulefc = status.func_code left join (select bsad.acvt_qst_answer as answer, bsad.sid as sid from base_store_acvt_dis bsad join base_acvt_qst baq on baq.acvtId = bsad.acvtId and baq.acvtQstId = bsad.acvtQstId where baq.qstCod='smallImgUrl') acvtdis on acvtdis.sid = store.store_Id left join (select vsad.acvt_qst_answer as answer, vsad.gen_id as gen_id ,vsad.emp_id as empid from visit_store_acvt_data vsad join base_acvt_qst baq on baq.acvtId = vsad.acvtId and baq.acvtQstId = vsad.acvtQstId where baq.isAcvtName ='9' and baq.qstType = 'P') locacvtdis on locacvtdis.gen_id = store.acvt_genId left join( select distinct acvt_qst_answer,baq.qstName,bsad.sid from base_store_acvt_dis bsad join base_acvt ba on ba._id=bsad.acvtId and ba.acvtCode='store_attribute_icon' join base_acvt_qst baq on baq.acvtId=ba._id and baq._id=bsad.acvtQstId )attribute on attribute.sid=store.store_Id left join( select distinct acvt_qst_answer,baq.qstName,bsad.sid from base_store_acvt_dis bsad join base_acvt ba on ba._id=bsad.acvtId and ba.acvtCode='store_msg' join base_acvt_qst baq on baq.acvtId=ba._id and baq._id=bsad.acvtQstId )store_month_visit_timeDis on store_month_visit_timeDis.sid=store.store_Id left join (SELECT sid,GROUP_CONCAT(optName) as optName FROM (select acvt_qst_answer,opt.optName optName,bsad.sid from base_store_acvt_dis bsad join base_acvt ba on ba._id=bsad.acvtId and ba.acvtCode='searchStore' join base_acvt_qst baq on baq.qsttype='DB' and baq.acvtId=ba._id and baq._id=bsad.acvtQstId join base_acvt_qst_opt opt on baq.acvtQstid = opt.acvtQstId and opt._id = bsad.acvt_qst_answer) GROUP BY sid) storeStatus on storeStatus.sid=store.store_Id left join (select bsad.acvt_qst_answer as answer, bsad.sid from visit_store_acvt_data bsad join base_acvt_qst baq on baq.acvtId = bsad.acvtId and baq._id = bsad.acvtQstId and baq.isAcvtName='17' ) localOrangeStore on localOrangeStore.sid=store.store_Id left join (SELECT sid,acvt_qst_answer as monthVisitNumber FROM (select acvt_qst_answer,bsad.sid from base_store_acvt_dis bsad join base_acvt ba on ba._id=bsad.acvtId and ba.acvtCode='searchStore' join base_acvt_qst baq on baq.qstCod = 'byybf_bq' and baq.acvtId=ba._id and baq._id=bsad.acvtQstId) GROUP BY sid) storeStatus1 on storeStatus1.sid=store.store_Id left join (SELECT sid,acvt_qst_answer as monthHelpVisitNumber FROM (select acvt_qst_answer,bsad.sid from base_store_acvt_dis bsad join base_acvt ba on ba._id=bsad.acvtId and ba.acvtCode='searchStore' join base_acvt_qst baq on baq.qstCod = 'byyzx_bq' and baq.acvtId=ba._id and baq._id=bsad.acvtQstId) GROUP BY sid) storeStatus2 on storeStatus2.sid=store.store_Id where $storeEmpId$ $statusEmpId$ and status.[status] in(1,2) $search_objId$ and store.store_Id not in ( select bsv.store_id from ws_base_store_visitplan bsv where $bsvBiz_date$ $bsvEmpId$ and bsv.store_id is not null) group by store.[store_Id] order by ifnull(status.[status],0), store.ID,cast(store.[seq] as int)

select a.acvtName acvtName, a.funcsName funcsName from ( select ba.acvtName, va.[store_id], func.name as funcsName from base_acvt ba join base_store_acvt bsa on $bsaStoreId$ and bsa.acvtId=ba._id and ba.[isReq]='1' join (select filter,b.name from base_funcs b join(select subCode from base_funcs where $parentId$ $storeTypeWhere$) a on b.subCode like a.subCode ||'%' and fv='V20A01' ) func on func.filter=ba.typ left join visit_store_acvt va on ba.[_id]=va.acvt_id $vaStoreId$ $emp_id$ )a where a.store_id is null

select a.name, a.status, a.fc,a.fv,a.ds from ( select func.name, vsa.status , func.fc , func.fv,func.ds, vsa.is_required, vsa.dict_id FROM base_funcs func left join visit_store_action vsa on func.fc=vsa.func_code and vsa.store_id='$storeId$' where func.subCode like (select subCode from base_funcs where _id= '$funcsId$' ) ||'%' and func.required='R' and func.fv<>'V20S99' and func.fv <> 'V20S01' $func_styp$ and vsa.emp_id = '$emp_id$' ) a where a.status is null or a.status <> '1' and a.is_required = 'R' and a.dict_id is null

select distinct acvt_dis.gen_id genId, ifnull(acvt_dis.opt_value,acvt_dis.acvt_qst_answer) answer, acvt.isacvtname isacvtname, acvt.qsttype qsttype,acvt_dis.acvtId acvtId,acvt_dis.acvtQstId acvtQstId, acvt.qstName qstName, acvt.countrule countrule,acvt_dis.getTime getTime, acvt_dis.acvt_qst_answer acvtanswer ,storeStatus.status status, acvt_dis.newStoreId newstoreid, store.name storeName, store.code storeCode, store.store_Id storeId from base_store_acvt_dis acvt_dis left join ws_base_store_table store on store.acvt_genId = acvt_dis.gen_id left join visit_store_status storeStatus on acvt_dis.newStoreId = storeStatus.store_id join ( select acvt._id acvtId, acvt_qst._id acvtQstId, acvt_qst.isAcvtName isacvtname, acvt_qst.qsttype qsttype, acvt_qst._id acvtQstId,acvt_qst.seq,acvt_qst.qstName,acvt_qst.countrule from base_acvt acvt join base_acvt_qst acvt_qst on acvt._id=acvt_qst.acvtId and acvt.typ=? )acvt on acvt_dis.acvtId=acvt.acvtId and acvt_dis.acvtQstId=acvt.acvtQstId join ( select gen_id, seq from ( SELECT gen_id,GROUP_CONCAT(ifnull(opt_value,acvt_qst_answer)) answer, min(_id) seq FROM base_store_acvt_dis GROUP BY gen_id ) where 1=1 $optNamelike$ --and (answer like '%宝%') ) likeResult on likeResult.gen_id=acvt_dis.gen_id where 1=1 $storeIdWhere$ --and acvt_dis.sid is not null $isSearchWhere$ --and acvt_dis.is_search is null $genIdWhere$ --and acvt_dis.gen_id is not null $empIdWhere$ order by likeResult.seq,acvt.seq

select distinct acvt_dis.gen_id genId, ifnull(acvt_dis.opt_value,acvt_dis.acvt_qst_answer) answer, acvt.isacvtname isacvtname, acvt.qsttype qsttype,acvt_dis.acvtId acvtId,acvt_dis.acvtQstId acvtQstId, acvt.qstName qstName, acvt.countrule countrule, acvt_dis.acvt_qst_answer acvtanswer,storeStatus.status status, acvt_dis.newStoreId newstoreid, store.name storeName, store.code storeCode, store.store_Id storeId from visit_store_acvt_data acvt_dis left join ws_base_store_table store on store.acvt_genId = acvt_dis.gen_id left join visit_store_status storeStatus on store.store_Id = storeStatus.store_id and storeStatus.store_id is not null join ( select acvt._id acvtId, acvt_qst._id acvtQstId, acvt_qst.isAcvtName isacvtname, acvt_qst.qsttype qsttype, acvt_qst.qsttype||acvt_qst._id typeAcvtQstId,acvt_qst.seq,acvt_qst.qstName,acvt_qst.countrule from base_acvt acvt join base_acvt_qst acvt_qst on acvt._id=acvt_qst.acvtId and acvt.typ=? )acvt on acvt_dis.acvtId=acvt.acvtId and (acvt_dis.acvtQstId=acvt.acvtQstId or acvt_dis.acvtQstId =acvt.qsttype||acvt.acvtQstId) join ( select gen_id, seq from ( SELECT gen_id,GROUP_CONCAT(ifnull(opt_value,acvt_qst_answer)) answer, min(_id) seq FROM visit_store_acvt_data GROUP BY gen_id ) where 1=1 $optNamelike$ --and (answer like '%宝%') ) likeResult on likeResult.gen_id=acvt_dis.gen_id where 1=1 $storeIdWhere$ $empIdWhere$ $genIdWhere$ order by likeResult.seq desc,acvt.seq

select acvt_dis._id id , acvt_dis.acvt_qst_answer acvt_qst_answer, acvt.ds ds, acvt.filter filter, acvt.acvtQstId acvtQstId from base_store_acvt_dis acvt_dis join ( select acvt._id acvtId, acvt_qst._id acvtQstId, acvt_qst.ds ds ,acvt_qst.filter filter from base_acvt acvt join base_acvt_qst acvt_qst on acvt._id=acvt_qst.acvtId and (acvt_qst.qsttype in( 'R','RD','C','CN','CD','SS','DV','SM','DM','CQ')) )acvt on acvt_dis.acvtId=acvt.acvtId and acvt_dis.acvtQstId=acvt.acvtQstId where gen_id is not null and acvt_dis.opt_value is null

select acvtdis.sid, funcs.fc, sum(length(acvtdis.acvt_qst_answer)-length(replace(acvtdis.acvt_qst_answer,',',''))+1) totalNum from base_acvt acvt join base_acvt_qst acvtqst on acvt._id=acvtqst.acvtId and acvtqst.qsttype='AN' join base_store_acvt_dis acvtdis on acvtdis.acvtId=acvt._id and acvtdis.acvtQstId=acvtqst._id join base_funcs funcs on funcs.filter=acvt.typ and funcs.ds='acvt' and funcs.opt like '%isRead = 4%' group by funcs.fc,acvtdis.sid

select distinct func_acvt.fc fc, acvt_dis.gen_id genId, acvt_dis.acvt_qst_answer = qst.countrule compare from base_store_acvt_dis acvt_dis join ( select a.fc fc, b.filter filter, acvt._id acvtId from (SELECT fc,fv,subCode FROM BASE_funcs where $fcWhere$) a join ( select filter,subCode from base_funcs where opt like '%isRead = 1%' and opt like '%isAdd = %' ) b on b.subCode like a.subCode ||'%' join base_acvt acvt on acvt.typ = b.filter ) func_acvt on acvt_dis.acvtId=func_acvt.acvtId join base_acvt_qst qst on qst.acvtId = acvt_dis.acvtId and qst._id=acvt_dis.acvtQstId where qst.countrule is not null
union all
select distinct func_acvt.fc fc, acvt_dis.gen_id genId, acvt_dis.acvt_qst_answer = qst.countrule compare from visit_store_acvt_data acvt_dis join ( select a.fc fc, b.filter filter, acvt._id acvtId from (SELECT fc,fv,subCode FROM BASE_funcs where $fcWhere$) a join ( select filter,subCode from base_funcs where opt like '%isRead = 1%' and opt like '%isAdd = %' ) b on b.subCode like a.subCode ||'%' join base_acvt acvt on acvt.typ = b.filter ) func_acvt on acvt_dis.acvtId=func_acvt.acvtId join base_acvt_qst qst on qst.acvtId = acvt_dis.acvtId and qst._id=acvt_dis.acvtQstId where qst.countrule is not null

select acvt_dis._id id, acvt_dis.acvt_qst_answer acvt_qst_answer, acvt.ds ds, acvt.filter filter, acvt.acvtQstId acvtQstId from visit_store_acvt_data acvt_dis join ( select acvt._id acvtId, acvt_qst._id acvtQstId, acvt_qst.ds ds ,acvt_qst.filter filter from base_acvt acvt join base_acvt_qst acvt_qst on acvt._id=acvt_qst.acvtId and (acvt_qst.qsttype in( 'R','RD','C','CN','CD','SS','DV','SM','DM','CQ')) )acvt on acvt_dis.acvtId=acvt.acvtId and acvt_dis.acvtQstId=acvt.acvtQstId where gen_id is not null and acvt_dis.opt_value is null

select distinct acvt_dis.gen_id genId, ifnull(acvt_dis.opt_value,acvt_dis.acvt_qst_answer) answer, acvt.isacvtname isacvtname, acvt.qsttype qsttype,acvt_dis.acvtId acvtId, acvt.qstName qstName, acvt.countrule countrule, acvt_dis.acvt_qst_answer acvtanswer,acvt.acvtQstId acvtQstId, acvt.qstCod qstCode from visit_store_acvt_data acvt_dis left join ( select acvt._id acvtId, acvt_qst._id acvtQstId, acvt_qst.isAcvtName isacvtname, acvt_qst.qsttype qsttype, acvt_qst.qsttype||acvt_qst._id typeAcvtQstId,acvt_qst.seq,acvt_qst.qstName,acvt_qst.countrule,acvt_qst.qstCod from base_acvt acvt join base_acvt_qst acvt_qst on acvt._id=acvt_qst.acvtId )acvt on acvt_dis.acvtId=acvt.acvtId and acvt_dis.acvtQstId=acvt.acvtQstId where 1=1 $acvtIdWhere$ $storeIdWhere$ $genIdWhere$ $empIdWhere$

select distinct acvt_dis.gen_id genId, ifnull(acvt_dis.opt_value,acvt_dis.acvt_qst_answer) answer, acvt.isacvtname isacvtname, acvt.qsttype qsttype,acvt_dis.acvtId acvtId,acvt_dis.acvtQstId acvtQstId, acvt.qstName qstName, acvt.countrule countrule, acvt_dis.acvt_qst_answer acvtanswer, acvt_dis.newStoreId newstoreid from visit_store_acvt_data acvt_dis join ( select acvt._id acvtId, acvt_qst._id acvtQstId, acvt_qst.isAcvtName isacvtname, acvt_qst.qsttype qsttype, acvt_qst.qsttype||acvt_qst._id typeAcvtQstId,acvt_qst.seq,acvt_qst.qstName,acvt_qst.countrule from base_acvt acvt join base_acvt_qst acvt_qst on acvt._id=acvt_qst.acvtId and acvt.typ=? )acvt on acvt_dis.acvtId=acvt.acvtId and (acvt_dis.acvtQstId=acvt.acvtQstId or acvt_dis.acvtQstId =acvt.qsttype||acvt.acvtQstId) $optNamelike$ $storeIdWhere$ $empIdWhere$
